title: JWST observations and aeon initiations
html: Observations from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) identify extremely compact, luminous objects in the early universe (z \sim 4 - 10), such as GLIMPSE-17775. These objects exhibit extreme Balmer breaks, broad H-\alpha emission, and high-metallicity spikes without X-ray bremsstrahlung. We formalize these objects algebraically as localized aeon initiation events. Their physical observables derive from the convex algebraic geometry of the Hecke algebra's spectrahedron. We scale the algebraic structure of the photon-electron transfer matrix T_{\gamma e} to these macroscopic observables.
